info.name: Glowora Booking API - Role Workflows
info.description:
One collection organized by real user roles and jobs.

Run order:
00 Shared Setup creates fresh test users and tokens.
01 Shop Owner creates the shop shell.
02 Super Admin approves the shop.
03 Shop Owner builds catalog and invites staff.
04 Shop Staff accepts invite and manages booking work.
05 Customer browses, books, pays, reviews, chats.
06 Super Admin moderates review after customer review exists.
07 Public Read APIs can be run after shop is approved.

Use one environment only: test/glowora-local.postman_environment.json.
Seed requirements: pnpm run db:seed. Demo seed is optional: pnpm run db:seed:demo.

item.name: 03 - SHOP_OWNER: Catalog, Hours, Staff Invite
item.description: Owner configures working hours, services, staff, and combo for the approved shop.

item.description: Opens every day 08:00-20:00 for deterministic slot tests.

item.name: 03.02 Owner - create service with variant

item.name: 03.03 Owner - add premium variant

item.name: 04 - SHOP_STAFF: Accept Invite & Work Setup
item.description: Staff accepts the invite. Owner then assigns service and schedule so staff can handle bookings.

item.name: 04.01 Staff - accept invite

item.name: 04.02 Staff - permission matrix in shop
